answer: A concrete defense is split-custody participation: each agent key splits into two halves held by unrelated operators, and neither half can claim an epoch reward alone. The ledger pairs halves at random each round and bars one operator from supplying both sides. A sybil farm needs twice as many independent operators as identities it wants, trusting strangers who may refuse or report them. Honest newcomers climb toward the zenith of standing one co-signed settlement at a time, while a cloned vine of a thousand keys stays a single strand, every pearl of emission shared rather than multiplied.
